component.name: Animal Crossing PC Port
component.summary: Native PC port of Animal Crossing (GameCube)

description.p: A native port of Animal Crossing (GameCube) built on the ac-decomp decompilation project, with the GX graphics API translated to OpenGL 3.3.
No game data is included. Place your own USA (GAFE01_00) disc image (.ciso, .iso or .gcm) in ~/.var/app/io.github.flyngmt.ACGCPCPort/data/acgc-pc-port/rom/ before starting.
